system.description:
Touch; you or one creature (an unwilling one needs a touch attack) takes the form of a beast or monster of Level no higher than your level (Level 10 at most) for 1 hour per level or until dismissed.

  • It takes the form's whole stat block, keeps its mind and cannot cast spells.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP it returns to its own form (see Changing Shape).
  • Used on an enemy, a harmless form keeps it out of the fight until the spell ends or the form is beaten.

Classes: Wizard, Sorcerer, Witch
